parameters.content:
## Social Listening & Response Workflow

Starter template from agentmelt.com — configure before running:

1. Fill in "Config (edit me)" (name, approver, quiet hours; test_mode stays on for the first week).
2. Add credentials to every service node (Anthropic, mail, CRM, database…).
3. Replace placeholder URLs, queries and field mappings with yours.
4. Set the trigger: Hourly pulls from each source's API or a listening provider; high-severity classifications trigger immediate alerts.
5. Keep the gates: 'Needs a person?' after every AI step, 'Approved?' after the approval — wire their dead ends to a sheet or a channel.
6. Keep the guardrails:
   - Nothing is posted publicly without human approval; the agent drafts.
   - Complaints are acknowledged publicly and resolved privately — the agent never debates in public.
   - PR-risk classifications bypass drafting and go straight to a person.
   - Author reach and account age feed urgency so a journalist's question is not treated like a bot's.

Full blueprint and pricing: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/social-listening-response/
Want it built and run for you? $247/month · custom $3,500–6,000 one-time

nodes.name: Config (edit me)
nodes.notes:
Fill these in once; every later node reads them as $('Config (edit me)').item.json.config.*

test_mode = true: log what the workflow would write, without writing it, for the first week.
approval_mode = true: the approval node waits for a person; switch off per message type once it has earned it.

Also point the nodes at your own sources:
- Platform APIs (X, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube) or a listening provider (Brand24, Mention)
- Review sites (G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, app stores)
- News API
- CRM and help desk for routing
- Brand voice guide and approved responses

De-duplicate and filter

Removes reposts, bots and irrelevant homonyms (a keyword that is also a common word) using rules learned from prior corrections.

Classify intent and sentiment

Buying question, complaint, support request, praise, competitor comparison, PR risk, irrelevant — plus sentiment and an urgency score based on author reach and tone.

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Draft the response" step of the Social Listening & Response Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: For replyable categories, a short response in your brand voice that answers the actual question, references the right resource, and never argues. Complaints get an acknowledgement and a route to support, not a public defence.

Rules:
- Nothing is posted publicly without human approval; the agent drafts.
- Complaints are acknowledged publicly and resolved privately — the agent never debates in public.
- PR-risk classifications bypass drafting and go straight to a person.
- Author reach and account age feed urgency so a journalist's question is not treated like a bot's.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.

nodes.name: Switch: Route by category
nodes.notes:
Route by category

Buying questions and comparisons → sales with a CRM lead; complaints and support → help desk ticket; PR risk → comms lead alert; praise → approved reply and a testimonial candidate list.

nodes.name: Wait: Approve and post
nodes.notes:
Approve and post

Drafts wait in Slack for one-click approval by the social manager; approved replies post through the platform API or are handed to the community manager where APIs restrict posting.

nodes.name: Google Sheets: Log everything
nodes.notes:
Log everything

Every mention, classification, action and response time is logged for the report and the classifier's feedback loop.
